notes.title: GAME UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
We have cross a major milestone, the Don't Bleed game update is live.  There has been a ton of updates, game design changes, and more.  Thank you for your patience and support!  We didn't quit and we are very proud of this update!  We also have more in store for you, just stick with us, it will only be getting better.

[b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] First Person to Third Person (bonus)
[*] Weapons with abilities
[*] Audio (Feedback, Background, etc.)
[*] More Characters
[*] Character Customization
[*] Weapon Customization
[*] Improved Lobby System
[*] Server by Country
[*] And More...
[/list]
[b]Public Service Announcement to those with KEYS:[/b]
[u]You better update the build![/u]
 
All we ask is that you get a group of friends to play to truly experience [b]Don't Bleed.[/b]

~Maven

notes.title: We Missed You All...
notes.content:
Hey, so we have been steady updating [b]Don't Bleed[/b], shout out to all of our SUPPORTERS!  You give us the energy to push through these long nights.  So, we are revealing major game updates at OiX in Orlando, Florida.  We hope you all enjoy these game changes!  Here is a list of changed or new features:
[list]
[*]Third Person Perspective
[*]Weapons (yes, we added guns, I'm kinda sad about that)
[*]Night Environment
[*]Leecher Enhancements
[*]Lobby Room for Players waiting to get into match
[*]And more...
[/list]

notes.title: Secrets of Development...
notes.content:
[b](Whispering voice)[/b]
Hey, psst.  I'm not supposed to be telling you this but, I feel updates are necessary!  

[u][b]Pros[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Terrain Environment Updates are Complete, first pass that is. What does that mean?  Well the terrain has been totally re-done!  We have also completed all external and internal props.  Second Pass of the terrain will occur in one week (meaning we are adding more prop content)...
[*]Leecher Animations Complete, now we will be integrating into game for timing and sequencing to make the Leecher movements look natural in game.
[*]Update to Unity 2018 Beta Complete but, I'll tell you later about the issues.
[/list]

[u][b]Cons[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Update to Unity 2018 Beta [b]BROKE[/b] the damn terrain (excuse my french)...  So, we are spending our time bug fixing at the moment, the problem is with how Unity 2018 is handling textures and shaders.  Jump on our DISCORD to get an ear full.
[/list]


So, visually the game has progressed significantly.  We have also managed to keep a high fps count (>50).  Oh, did I mention we got rid of the FOG!  Yes, yes, it is gone, no more fog (we only use it in the horizon by the water).  There are new options for in game player characters (yup added a female and more).
